How to play
1 player ←→ move Space/Z jump (press again for a double jump) X attack ↑↓→ + attack: specials C guard (+ direction to roll) ↓ + jump: drop through Enter pause C+X (guard + attack): Super Attack when your purple super meter is full (it fills as you deal and take damage) ` or double-click the screen: fullscreen
Keys 1 WASD move Space/F jump G attack E/Q guard Keys 2 ←↑↓→ move / jump . attack , guard
Keys 3 IJKL move U jump O attack Y guard Keys 4 Numpad 8456 move 0 jump . attack + guard
Up to 8 players in Battle: 4 keyboard players + up to 8 gamepads (A jump · B/X attack · bumpers/triggers guard · Start pause). Give each player a fixed keyboard or controller in Controllers · Options · Records › PLAYERS, or press GUARD on a new controller at fighter select to take over a player.
Green leaf swipe · → boomerang leaf · ↑ leaf tornado · ↓ leaf storm. Hold jump to glide.
Blue water squirt · → wave surf · ↑ geyser · ↓ trap bubble. Fast in water.
Yellow spark · → thunder dash · ↑ thunder jump · ↓ sky bolt
Orange brick punch · → brick toss · ↑ brick tower · ↓ brick slam. Heavy and tough.
Pink lipstick combo · → blown kiss (dizzies) · ↑ heart balloon · ↓ lipstick spin
Red inhale a foe, then attack to spit them out as fire · → fireball · ↑ flare · ↓ fire dive. Can't inhale with a full mouth.
Purple 5 jumps · hammer · → hammer flip · ↑ final cutter · ↓ stone
Weng cloud puff · → rain cloud (drizzles on foes below) · ↑ cloud lift · ↓ fog burst that dizzies (in the air: cloud drop). Hold jump to float.
Cyan (potion genius) bottle bonk · → throws potions in turn: fire, poison puddle, ice freeze · ↑ fizzy rocket · ↓ brain wave + healing potion (every 10s)
Lime (from the future, super fast) hyper jabs · → warp dash · ↑ time spring · ↓ time stop freezes nearby foes (every 6s)
Light Yellow (cat Yummico) claw swipes · → pounce · ↑ cat flip · ↓ scratch frenzy (in the air: claw dive)
Yippee (guest, not a Yummico) punch flurry · → tongue lash · ↑ rocket uppercut · ↓ tongue snag pulls foes in for a punch (in the air: meteor fist)
Your own Yummico pick Create Your Own on the title screen: Yummico or Yippee style, body and hands & feet colours, antenna, hair, any fighter's powers and a name. Saved in this browser.
Gold (secret prankster, unlocks when you clear Extra Mode) joy buzzer · → cream pie (dizzies) · ↑ spring jump · ↓ banana peel trap (in the air: whoopee cushion drop)
White (secret god Yummico with a halo, unlocks when you finish story mode) holy smite · → divine beam · ↑ ascension · ↓ judgment pillars on both sides (in the air: heavenly dive). Hold jump to float.
Road to Black 18 stages. Side-scrolling levels: walk right, jump the pits, bop the critters (Grumbles, Hoppers, Buzzes, Starlings, Spikies, Flameys and Dr. Grey's robots), then the gate shuts and brawlers drop in. Bosses: King Grumble, Queen Buzzbee and Magmaw from Yummico Adventure 64, plus Navy, Dark Weng and Neon. Neon's pulse flips your left and right for a few seconds!
Levels have star blocks (hit them), bomb blocks (they blow up their neighbours), springs, switches that open gates, electric fences, checkpoint flags and 3 hidden Yummi Gems each. Your progress saves by itself: Continue Story, Level Select, Boss Rush (clear the story or find 12 gems) and villains you beat become playable. Controllers, button remapping, rumble, volume and records are under Controllers · Options · Records.
Role Play pick any arena or a big level world, up to 8 players on one screen, friendly (no damage) or play-fight (nobody gets KO'd), plus wandering CPU friends. Hold GUARD 2 and press ◀ ▶ to choose something to say, let go to say it.
New in 2.1! ULTIMATE ARENA · EXTREME (after beating Paint): every fighter with an energy shield, every boss, and enemy hordes, with rest stops. The final boss depends on you: Blue, Yellow, Green or Orange with all 21 Yummi Gems fight Universe Yippee as a Super form the whole fight; everyone else fights Murk, and with all 21 gems then Super Duper Ultra Neon, the neon knight. Beat Universe Yippee or Ultra Neon to play as them. 2.0: ONLINE on the title screen (in the downloaded game and the app): host a room and share the 4-letter code, or type a friend's code to join. Up to 4 players can battle online (add CPUs too), or hang out together in online Role Play. 1.9: The Upgrade Shop now has 7 upgrades (Health, Power, Speed, Jump, Defense, Healing, Lucky Coins) and each one goes up to level 20. Auto-scrolling parts now show the moving edge of the screen, scroll a bit slower, and wait for you if blocks are in the way. Background trees and buildings now stand on the ground. 1.8: Bosses are easier: change it any time in Settings → OPTIONS → BOSS DIFFICULTY (Easy, Normal or Hard). Phones and tablets get a drag joystick, bigger buttons, an ⬆ ATTACK button for recovering, a ★ SUPER button, and a new TOUCH settings tab (button size, see-through, left-handed, arrow buttons, auto-recover from pits, vibration). 1.7: Clear the Arena to unlock Midnight Blue (moon boomerang, shadow dash, and a MIDNIGHT SKY super attack). Beat Indigo in any fight to unlock Strawberry as a fighter. Indigo's buddy Strawberry can now be hit too: if he's knocked out he naps for 8 seconds, then comes back. 1.6: Chapter 2: Grey's Revenge (after Road to Black): 20 new levels with 6-7 longer parts, conveyor belts, wind fans, slippery ice, cannons (smash them!), bounce bubbles, rolling spike balls, keys and locked doors, and crumbling platforms. The Custom Crew now has 8 members. Beat Mega Grey-Bot to unlock Grey-Bot. The Arena now has every fighter. Beat Rainbow to open the True Arena: hard versions of everyone, then Paint, a glitchy 2D copycat. Beat Paint to unlock Indigo, a kid who fights with her buddy Strawberry. Special + DOWN turns Indigo into a kitty, bunny or birdie (and back), each with new attacks.
New! Story levels now have 4-6 parts: press UP at doors, step on trapdoors to drop underground, climb towers. Some parts auto-scroll, flood with water or lava, shift their platforms or go dark. Collect coins and spend them in the Upgrade Shop (press GUARD on the story map). Black is playable after the story; the Arena (every fighter, rest stops, then Rainbow, who wants to delete the world) opens after the story too. Find all 21 Yummi Gems and Blue, Yellow, Green and Orange can go Super mid-fight: fill the gold bar, then press GUARD + JUMP.
